title: Float array folds
summary: Relates a fold over an Array Float to a fold over the array of its elements' bit patterns, which is how an Array Float is stored and what the compiler's fold statement computes.
premises: A borrowed Array Float, represented as the Array UInt64 of its elements' Float.toBits
Each step of the source fold maps under h to the step g on bit patterns
result: (xs.map Float.toBits).foldl g (h init) = h (xs.foldl f init), which turns the accumulator word from Stmt.fold_spec into the bits of the source fold's result.
